source_check_state.policy: Authoritative contemporary sources were used selectively only where register, licensing, rare-vs-ordinary status, or regional usage materially changed the Truth decision.

interpretation: REVISE does not mean the whole word is unusable. It means Current differs materially from the target learner-worthy Truth in at least one semantic dimension.

Many REVISE decisions are organization/priority/ownership defects: duplicate Active+secondary objects, dictionary micro-senses promoted to main depth, structures attached to the wrong sense, or a weak Core/Word Feel that fails to organize otherwise valid meanings.

A meaningful minority are hard Knowledge defects: ordinary meanings missing while specialist senses survive, over-merges that erase distinct POS/meanings, factually invalid examples/definitions, wrong transitivity, zero Active senses under a meaningful Core, or cross-word relations pointing at the wrong sense/POS.
The 45% REVISE rate in this first full ordinal batch is high enough that prior Natural Owner cutover/build/runtime success cannot be treated as semantic Knowledge acceptance.
The audit method is calibrated: simple correct words are being passed quickly; complex words receive deeper review; external checking is selective rather than ritual.
